bias.en: Downtrend · broke $117.4, new low since listing
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $117.4，创上市以来新低

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 13.1% on Nov 20 to $103.57, its lowest close since listing, trading $102.45–117.89 on heavy volume (1.67x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($118.0), 10-day ($126.6) and 30-day ($138.9), all falling (no 100-day or 200-day yet, 95 sessions). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($151.69), and RSI is 30.4.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月20日下跌 13.1%，收于 $103.57，为上市以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $102.45–117.89，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 1.67 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$118.0）、10 日（$126.6）和 30 日均线（$138.9）下方，均在下行（上市仅 95 个交易日，尚无 100 日和 200 日均线）。MACD 自 11月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$151.69），RSI 为 30.4。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $115–119.9 (Nov 17–19 lows, round number), now resistance, leaving no trading history below. Resistance is $115–117.9 (Nov 17 low, Nov 20 high), then $118–120.5 (5-day, Nov 16 low) and $122.2–123.9. Support is $102.45 (Nov 20 low, listing low), then round numbers $100 and $95. A close above $117.9 would target $118–120.5; below $102.45, $100.
read.zh: 此次下跌跌破此前三道支撑 $115–119.9（11月17日至19日低点、整数关口），转为阻力，下方已无交易历史。阻力为 $115–117.9（11月17日低点、11月20日高点），其次 $118–120.5（5 日均线、11月16日低点）和 $122.2–123.9。支撑为 $102.45（11月20日低点、上市以来低点），其次 $100 和 $95 整数关口。若收盘站上 $117.9，下一目标看 $118–120.5；若跌破 $102.45，则看 $100。

bias.en: Downtrend · back under the 5-day, at the ₩1,113,000 low
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 重回 5 日均线下方，位于 ₩1,113,000 低点

read.en: The latest Seoul bar is flat at ₩1,113,000, carrying the Nov 19 close; that session fell 5.9% from ₩1,183,000, trading ₩1,096,000–1,124,000. It is below the 5-day (₩1,130,200), 10-day (₩1,173,000), 30-day (₩1,275,500) and 100-day (₩1,640,200), all falling, and the rising 200-day (₩1,530,600). MACD is back below its signal, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 (₩1,402,500), and RSI is 37.9.

The Nov 19 drop gave back the Nov 18 gain, losing the ₩1,144,000–1,182,300 supports (5- and 10-day, Nov 17 close), now resistance, and closed on the ₩1,113,000 Nov 15 low. Resistance is ₩1,124,000–1,130,200 (Nov 19 high, 5-day), then ₩1,144,000–1,150,000 and ₩1,171,000–1,186,000. Support is ₩1,089,000–1,099,000 (Nov 5, 16 and 19 lows), then ₩1,056,000–1,060,000 and ₩1,042,000. A close above ₩1,130,200 would target ₩1,144,000–1,150,000; below ₩1,089,000, ₩1,056,000–1,060,000.
